description: This file defines a custom exception class VueControllerException within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the namespace OrangeHRM\Core\Controller\Exception. The class extends the built-in Exception class and provides a static method for generating a specific exception message indicating a request handling issue.

classes.name: VueControllerException
classes.description: A custom exception class used within the Vue Controller in the OrangeHRM core controller exception namespace. Provides a static method to generate a specific exception when a request has already been handled.

methods.name: alreadyHandled
methods.description: Returns a new instance of VueControllerException with a predefined message indicating that the request has already been handled and the component cannot be changed.

calls: new self("Request already handled, cannot change the component")
